# Lagomorph
Lagomorphs are an artifically-uplifted species of anthromorphic mammals that have a strange resemblance to Earth's rabbits.
## Racial Features - Their blood has a dark red color. - Their metabolism processes chemicals [color=#ffa500]33% faster[/color]. - They [color=#1e90ff]can regenerate stamina faster and gain stamina resistance[/color] for [color=yellow]20[/color] seconds, in exchange for increased hunger and thirst drain while active. This ability has a cooldown of [color=yellow]30[/color] seconds between uses. - They can begin [color=#1e90ff]running 35% faster[/color] for [color=yellow]10[/color] seconds, in exchange for increased hunger and thirst drain while active. This ability has a cooldown of [color=yellow]30[/color] seconds between uses. - thanks to their large ears, they [color=#1e90ff]can hear people speak and whisper from 2 tiles further[/color]. - Due to their fur, they receive [color=#ffa500]25% more heat damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]25% less cold damage[/color], as well as [color=#1e90ff]10% less blunt damage[/color]. - Their claws deal [color=red]5[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Language The Lagomorph language, known as Laguine, is composed of soft squeaks and laryanixcal noises. It is often described as cute and not too difficult to learn.
## Age and Names Lagomorphs are a short lives species, reaching adulthood at around 6 years of age and being capable of living up to 90 years. They lack any particular naming convention of their own, instead Lagomorph parents adapt the local one for their children, who are named at birth.
